applies_to: rénovation d'ampleur, houses (BAR-TH-174) and flats (BAR-TH-175); owner-occupiers/landlords (natural persons, main residence): ANAH applications filed from 2024-01-01; other cases: operations engaged from 2024-01-01
act: Arrêté du 19 décembre 2023 (Rénovation d'ampleur des maisons individuelles et des appartements)
content: BAR-TH-164 (rénovation performante d'une maison individuelle) and its Coup de pouce abolished (quotes signed from 2024-01-01; earlier works keep it if finished by 2025-12-31 and declared by 2024-01-15). New fiches BAR-TH-174/175 with criteria aligned on MPR parcours accompagné. For main residences of natural persons, only ANAH can claim these CEE and folds their value into MPR accompagné (per FFB). New Coup de pouce 'Rénovation d'ampleur des maisons et appartements individuels' for remaining cases (second homes, social housing).
ne_note: Private CEE top-ups for global renovation of owner-occupied main residences disappear and are absorbed into MPR accompagné on the same day as the MPR 2024 reform: shifts the funding mix, but the date is confounded with the MPR reform.

applies_to: heat pumps air/water (BAR-TH-171) and water/water or ground/water (BAR-TH-172); operations engaged from 2024-01-01
act: Arrêté du 20 décembre 2023 portant création et révision de fiches
content: Revision of BAR-TH-171/172 before they ever applied (both created by Arrêté du 4 octobre 2023, JORFTEXT000048158900, v. A55.1, for operations from 2024-01-01, replacing BAR-TH-104 'PAC air/eau ou eau/eau', abolished the same day). Diff Oct vs Dec 2023 text: kWh cumac amounts, surface and zone factors identical; only change is that the seasonal efficiency threshold (126% low temp / 111% medium-high temp) is assessed according to the application the PAC is installed for, not the PAC's design type, with matching proof-of-works wording. Also BAR-TH-127 (single-flow VMC) revised from 2024-04-01; new BAR-TH-176 (water-heater regulation).
status: verified (Légifrance API: JORF text of both arrêtés; fiche texts in data/cee/)
ne_note: Technical clarification only. The substantive change is BAR-TH-104 (v. A41.3) -> BAR-TH-171 on 2024-01-01: flat amount for any PAC with etas>=120% (house H2 65,400 kWhc) replaced by etas bands x usage (house H2: 37,600 heating-only at 111-140% up to 106,000 heating+DHW at >=200%); surface and zone factors unchanged; exclusion widened from PAC + high-performance boiler to PAC + any other heating system; regulator class IV-VIII required. Low-efficiency / heating-only installs lose CEE, efficient heating+DHW installs gain. See output/cee_heatpump_fiche_comparison.csv. Coup de pouce minimums (EUR 4,000 modest / 2,500 others for fossil-boiler replacement) are set separately in the charter.

status: listed on Légifrance; values not extracted

applies_to: Coup de pouce Chauffage; BAR-TH-163 (flue duct)
act: Arrêté du 22 mars 2024 (after Conseil d'État n° 469215 of 4 Jan 2024)
content: After the Conseil d'État partly annulled the 'modalités' arrêté, reinstates the removal of the condition that the replaced heating equipment be non-condensing (i.e. Coup de pouce Chauffage also available when replacing a condensing boiler). BAR-TH-163 Coup de pouce limited to operations engaged by 2024-12-31 (finished by 2025-12-31); fiche itself ends for operations from 2025-01-01.
ne_note: Legal gap between 2024-01-04 (CE decision) and 2024-03-30 for the condensing-boiler condition; probably too short/technical for identification.

applies_to: collective residential buildings (copropriétés, social housing); operations engaged from 2024-11-01 (2025-03-01 for copros whose AG voted BAR-TH-145 works before 2025-01-01, or permits filed before 2024-11-01)
act: Arrêté du 6 septembre 2024 modifiant le Coup de pouce « Rénovation performante de bâtiment résidentiel collectif »
content: BAR-TH-145 replaced by BAR-TH-177: flat forfait 2,100 kWhcumac/m² of habitable area after works, third-party control mandatory; new version of the collective Coup de pouce. Requirements: ≥35% primary-energy gain with prior audit, post-works < 331 kWhep/m².an, no coal/oil boilers, gas ≤30% outside heat networks.
ne_note: Relevant for MPR Copropriété (CEE often cumulated). The AG-date grandfathering rule gives a sharp assignment rule for copros (AG before/after 2025-01-01).

applies_to: insulation fiches (BAR-EN-101/102/103/105/106/107); BAR-TH-171/172; BAR-TH-177; Coup de pouce rénovation d'ampleur charter
content: Insulation fiches updated (reflective insulation norm) for operations engaged from 2025-01-01. Abrogation date of 2027-05-01 set for wall and flat-roof insulation fiches (BAR-EN-102, BAR-EN-105, BAR-EN-107). Heat-pump fiches: regulator brand/reference required. Rénovation d'ampleur Coup de pouce: control body cannot be the auditor.
ne_note: Scheduled end of CEE for wall insulation (2027-05-01) parallels the removal of wall insulation from MPR par geste (2026-01-01): two-step withdrawal of public support for wall insulation.

applies_to: Coup de pouce « Thermostat avec régulation performante »
content: Coup de pouce for connected room-by-room heating controls ended.

applies_to: collective boilers (BAR-TH-107, BAR-TH-107-SE); bonification of art. 5 of the 'modalités' arrêté
content: High-performance collective boiler fiches (BAR-TH-107/-SE) abolished. Completion deadline for operations under the art. 5 bonification pushed to 2026-12-31 (which bonus art. 5 covers not checked). BAR-TH-168/169 (solar systems) and BAR-SE-108/109 revised from 2025-04-01.
ne_note: End of CEE for collective gas boilers, coherent with the earlier MPR removal of gas boilers (2023).
